title: Make SMB microbolus threshold configurable
symptom: Values <= 0.3u are displayed as SMB (as a triangle) in xDrip, but SMB sometimes delivers 0.4u/0.5u microboluses. There is no option to configure the threshold, and xDrip does not differentiate between loop SMB and manual boluses that are very small.
cause: xDrip has a decluttering feature that for insulin treatments less than or equal to 0.3 units, the value is not shown and the symbol is a triangle. This causes small manual boluses to be displayed as SMB.
fix: Disable the decluttering feature by disabling the setting: Settings > Display settings > Graph settings > Show micro bolus icons. This will show all insulin treatments the same way regardless of value.
evidence_quote: You can disable this decluttering feature. To do that, disable the following: Settings > Display settings > Graph settings > Show micro bolus icons
